turn1.explanation: The strongest trigger is the tokens of a bird name (swan, owl, finch, kestrel, duck, sparrow, falcon, flamingo, heron), whether the word refers to the bird or is reused as a surname, title, idiom or acronym. A separate, weaker trigger (about 5-7) is abbreviated month names in dates, such as Sep, Oct., Nov., Aug., Feb., Sept.
turn1.evidence: All top examples peak on bird-name tokens even in non-bird uses: "Swan Lake", "lame duck", "green swan", the surnames Yvik Swan and M. Heron, Robert Falcon Scott, The Flamingos, the SWAN MRI sequence, and a Run-Kestrel command. Every mid-range example instead fires on an abbreviated month before a day number, and nothing links these to birds.
